title: (EPIC) The authorization seam: hand over attributes and predicates, never a verdict
design:
pkix-ac already decided 'parse all, interpret none': all six RFC 5755 attribute types parse, none are interpreted, because deciding what a Clearance permits is security policy belonging to the application -- it turns on a policy identifier the application owns, a lattice it defines, and often a classification scheme no library should encode.

This epic is that decision pushed one step: a seam that hands a host the attributes and the predicates to evaluate, and never a resolved verdict.

Deliberately split from the WASM host. The solver-shaped seam is nearly free; a sandboxed runtime is a different order of work and the largest attack surface anything here would ship. Tying them into one bead makes the cheap half wait on the expensive half.
